title: What's your phone number?
instructions: Yeni iki arkadaş numaralarını paylaşıyor. Kısa bir diyalog; sayıları dikkatle dinle.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: It's oh seven seven, four three two, nine eight one.

script.speaker: jon
script.text: Sorry, nine eight one or nine eight five?

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Nine eight one. And what is your email?

script.speaker: jon
script.text: It's jon at mail dot com.

questions.prompt: What does Jon ask for first?
questions.feedback: Jon önce telefon numarasını (phone number) soruyor.

questions.prompt: What are the last three numbers?
questions.feedback: Jon emin değil; Mia tekrar ediyor: nine eight one (981).
